question.text: Short-term capital gains (STCG) on equity mutual funds (holding period ≤ 12 months) are taxed at what rate in FY 2025-26?

explanation.text: The Logic: Short-term capital gains on equity-oriented mutual funds (units held for 12 months or less) fall under Section 111A. The Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 increased the Section 111A STCG rate from 15% to 20% for transfers on or after 23 July 2024, so for FY 2025-26 the applicable equity-MF STCG rate is 20% (plus applicable surcharge and cess). The Trap: 15% was the pre-July-2024 Section 111A rate, not the current one. Slab-rate taxation does not apply to equity-MF STCG (slab rates apply to debt-MF gains under the post-1 April 2023 regime). 12.5% is the current Section 112A LTCG rate for equity, not the STCG rate. Note: The 20% equity-MF STCG rate is not stated on the cited pages of the NISM-Series-X-A Investment Adviser (Level 1) workbook, which on the pages checked covers ELSS / 80C, FoF taxation and general liquidity rather than the current Section 111A rate. The framing above is general FY 2025-26 Indian income-tax knowledge.
